items.text: Schwab says it is bringing AI to deliver tax insights and trust and estate insights to clients, helping engage them more in wealth conversations.
items.quote: we're bringing AI to deliver tax insights and trust and estate insights to our clients. And that's helping us engage them more in wealth conversations

items.text: Schwab says it is reaching a growing number of clients through answer engine optimization work to ensure it shows up on the AI platforms where investors turn.
items.quote: We're already reaching a growing number of clients through the answer engine optimization work that our marketing team is doing to ensure we show up on the AI platforms where investors return.

items.text: Schwab says it is rolling out an AI managed capability to help clients think through their trading strategies so they can articulate and plan how to trade.
items.quote: We are rolling out an AI managed capability to help clients think through their trading strategies so they can clearly articulate and have a plan for how they're going to trade.

items.text: Morgan Stanley says it was overweight to AI from the early days in wealth with some of the work it did with OpenAI.
items.quote: we were, as you know, overweighted to AI from the early days in wealth with some of the work we did with OpenAI.

items.text: Morgan Stanley says that where it used to have two teams checking each other on documentation, it now has one human team and one AI team.
items.quote: we used to have two teams necessarily checking each other on different documentation to make sure things are right. We now have one human team and one AI team.

items.text: Bank of America says it is using AI-enabled tools to help bankers accelerate their research, prepare materials, and identify relevant client opportunities more efficiently.
items.quote: We're also using AI-enabled tools to help bankers accelerate their research, prepare materials, and identify relevant client opportunities more efficiently.

items.text: Bank of America says AI-enabled tools are now more embedded in workflows across operations, risk, finance, technology, and client-facing teams, helping reduce manual work and improve speed and consistency.
items.quote: AI-enabled tools are now more embedded in workflows across operations, risk, finance, technology, and our client-facing teams. And that's helped reduce manual work, improve speed and enhance consistency for clients and teammates.

cells.reason: Multiple passages across Raymond James, Schwab, Morgan Stanley and Bank of America state specific AI tools and capabilities they are deploying or developing for advice delivery, so this is a fact cell.
